backend/main.mo: Motoko backend canister defining stories, comments, reviews, user profiles, access control, and admin functions including story submission and article publishing.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Aggregated summaries of major frontend files describing their roles in routing, UI components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining IC canister setup, usage of frontend versus backend canister IDs, and basic deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React root and main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main routing setup using TanStack Router defining all application routes and layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing an access‑denied message with a button redirecting to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation header with brand, links, and conditional user menu based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared page layout providing header, footer, and wrapped content area.
Form component allowing users to submit comments for a story using useAddComment.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays a story’s comments with loading skeletons and timestamp formatting using useGetComments.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Shows comments for a story by reading all discussions via useGetAllDiscussions and formatting timestamps.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Diagnostics UI showing canister IDs and URLs with copy‑to‑clipboard actions for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Form for submitting star ratings and optional text reviews for a story using useAddReview.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Renders a story’s reviews with star ratings, timestamps, and loading states via useGetAllDiscussions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Admin hooks for fetching stories and publishing or creating articles using actor mutations with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Hook that checks backend heartbeat availability and returns reachability status with optional retry logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all discussions and adding a review, with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: React Query hooks for fetching stories, comments, submissions, and submitting new stories or comments with retry and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables, typography, and global UI styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that sets up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static about page presenting the author, project purpose, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface for reviewing, editing, publishing stories, and creating new articles with form handling and mutations.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Displays a published article with metadata and full content, including comments and error/loading states.
frontend/src/pages/ArticlesPage.tsx: Displays a list of published stories with loading and error states, and allows navigation to individual articles or story submission.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Shows author contact info, book details, email link, and social media buttons in a styled card.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Loads discussion topics and switches between comment and review threads with topic selection and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main stories feed with backend availability checks, error handling, retry logic, and navigation to story pages.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Provides a homepage hero section with navigation to read or submit stories and highlights site features like sharing and discussions.
frontend/src/pages/MySubmissionsPage.tsx: Shows authenticated users their story submissions with login gating, loading and error states, and submission status display.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Displays a full published story with metadata, handles loading/error states, and renders a comments section with composer and thread.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Provides a story submission form with authentication checks, submission handling, and success UI.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Shows troubleshooting help for unresolved canister IDs and displays detected canister info with copy utilities.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Generates and returns frontend/backend canister IDs and related URLs using hostname or env variables.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for adding an admin publishing flow and initial article, listing existing features and new feature requests. Includes version info, project metadata, and task statuses.
